# telnyx_10dlc_brand_revet (Action)

Asks The Campaign Registry to vet a 10DLC brand again, for example after correcting its details. Revetting is billable and allowed once after registration, then at most once every three months.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) The brand id.
